connector.name: Smarter Weather
connector.registryDescription: Smarter Weather MCP: forecasts, alerts, outlooks, observations, AQI, grids, and map imagery.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.smarterweather.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp-weather. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the smarterweather account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: SMARTERWEATHER_API_KEY
env.description: Smarter Weather API key (sw_live_* or sw_test_*) with the 'mcp' scope. When set, the bridge skips the OAuth flow and forwards the key as 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' on every proxied request. When unset, the bridge runs the full MCP OAuth 2.1 + PKCE client and caches tokens at ~/.mcp-auth/. Mint keys at https://smarterweather.com/developers/api-keys.

env.name: SMARTERWEATHER_MCP_URL
env.description: Override the target MCP endpoint. Useful for development or staging against a non-production sw-mcp deployment. Precedence: positional argument > SMARTERWEATHER_MCP_URL > package default (https://mcp.smarterweather.com/mcp).
